hero.subtitle: FHIRBridge converts hospital records locked in proprietary HIS systems into open FHIR R4 bundles — giving patients and clinicians true data portability across Vietnam, Korea, Japan, and beyond.

problem.title: Patient records are trapped in systems patients can't access
problem.p1: Across Vietnam and Japan, hospital information systems (HIS) store patient data in proprietary, siloed formats. When patients transfer to another hospital or move abroad, their records don't follow them.
problem.p2: FHIRBridge solves this by converting any structured hospital export into open, portable FHIR R4 bundles — the international standard that any modern healthcare system can read.

stats.markets: Markets with ready-made mappings and compliance notes: Vietnam, Korea, Japan and international
stats.sources: Ways to connect a hospital system: its FHIR API or a CSV / Excel export
stats.stored: Patient records stored by FHIRBridge — data is streamed, never persisted

features.title: Everything you need for patient data portability
features.subtitle: Built for the realities of Asian healthcare systems — messy data, multiple formats, strict privacy requirements.

fhir.title: FHIR R4 Standard
fhir.desc: 15 resource types — Patient, Encounter, Condition, Observation, MedicationRequest and more, plus International Patient Summary (IPS) bundles.

ai.title: AI Patient Summaries
ai.desc: Claude + OpenAI generate de-identified clinical summaries in plain language. Never stores PHI.

interfaces.title: Three Interfaces
interfaces.desc: CLI for power users, REST API for integrations, and a visual Web Dashboard — all in one package.

import.title: CSV / Excel Import
import.desc: JSON column mappings turn CSV / Excel exports into FHIR — with ready-made examples for Vietnam, Korea and Japan.

privacy.title: Privacy-by-Design
privacy.desc: Zero PHI storage — data streams in memory only. HMAC pseudonymization and SSRF/IDOR protections built in.

multilang.title: Multi-language
multilang.desc: Full UI and AI summaries in English, Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt), Japanese (日本語), and Korean (한국어).

how.title: From raw hospital data to FHIR in minutes
how.subtitle: Three simple steps. One setup command to get started.

connect.title: Connect
connect.desc: Connect to your HIS through its FHIR API, or upload a CSV / Excel export with a column mapping.

export.title: Export
export.desc: FHIRBridge maps your data to FHIR R4 resources in real time — Patient, Condition, Medication, Observation, and more.

summarize.title: Summarize
summarize.desc: Optionally generate an AI-powered clinical summary in English, Vietnamese, Japanese, or Korean — de-identified and stream-only.

security.title: Built for clinical environments
security.subtitle: Healthcare data demands the highest security standards. FHIRBridge ships with production-grade protections from day one.

zero_phi.title: Zero PHI Storage
zero_phi.desc: Patient data never persists. All processing is in-memory, stream-only.

hmac.title: HMAC-SHA256 Pseudonymization
hmac.desc: Identifiers are replaced with keyed HMAC-SHA256 hashes before any AI call; audit logs store hashes only.

ssrf.title: SSRF Protection
ssrf.desc: Requests to private networks and cloud metadata are blocked; internal HIS hosts must be allowlisted explicitly.

jwt.title: JWT & API-key Authentication
jwt.desc: HS256 tokens with required subject and expiry, or API keys compared in constant time. Logout revokes tokens that carry a jti.

idor.title: IDOR Protection
idor.desc: Resource ownership is verified on every request. No ID enumeration vulnerabilities.

rate_limit.title: Rate Limiting
rate_limit.desc: Per-user and per-IP throttling prevents abuse and protects upstream HIS endpoints.

audit.title: Audit Logging
audit.desc: Every export action is timestamped and logged for compliance and traceability.

headers.title: Security Headers
headers.desc: Content-Security-Policy, HSTS, frame and MIME-sniffing protections on every response.

open_source.title: Built in the open
open_source.subtitle: FHIRBridge is open source. Inspect the code, contribute improvements, or self-host with full control. No black boxes in healthcare.
